title: Why tiny JPEGs look different in Chrome
summary: A technical deep-dive into why Chrome renders tiny JPEG images differently than expected, exploring browser-specific image processing optimizations and scaling algorithms that affect visual output of small compressed images.
problem_solved: Explains the unexpected visual differences when viewing small JPEG images in Chrome compared to other browsers or expected output.
why_valuable: Helps web developers understand browser-specific image rendering behaviors, enabling them to debug visual inconsistencies and optimize images for cross-browser compatibility.
